tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows cover only short horizons, leaving the long-horizon behavior at H=21.5 unidentified. The recalled verified dual-horizon mechanism specifically predicts a sign reversal around H=15–25; acquire the targeted slow-horizon observation before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon endogenous-adaptation model from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed H values are 0.16–0.48, so they establish only short-window positive gain and do not identify a reversal near the target forecast horizon of 21.5.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a periodic Lotka–Volterra harmonic model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon rows do not distinguish periodic behavior from the supplied dual-horizon mechanism; the long-horizon probe is more directly discriminating.
The supplied signatures include sink-gradient dependence and endogenous adaptation, which this static curve does not explain.
A fine trajectory batch is unnecessary to resolve the key uncertainty: long-horizon sign reversal.
